jobs.description:
SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

We’re looking for a talented UI Artist to work with one of the biggest mobile games IP in the world: Subway Surfers.

Art has always been a northstar at SYBO, and we take great part in creating polished and high quality art that brings storytelling to life. Here you’ll join a seasoned group of artists all working closely together to make our games feel as good as it looks! We have a highly collaborative, feedback-friendly space where ideas bounce fast and bold, and where UI design really drives the player experience.

You’ll have the rare chance to shape UI at scale on either of our games, depending on which team you’ll be joining. If you’re the kind of artist who loves iterating, thrives on polish, and gets a kick out of elevating your team as much as your pixels - you’ll fit right in.

If above sounds interesting, and working with an IP that reaches hundreds of millions of players a month, read on!

**Responsibilities

**

• Create polished, lively UI art that enhances the established art direction and stays true to the Subway Surfers brand.

• Design intuitive and engaging UI screens, assets, and interactions for new and existing game features.

• Develop and present UI concepts and interactive prototypes that clearly communicate the intended look, feel, and player experience.

• Collaborate closely with the art, design and engineering to bring player-centric features from concept to implementation

• Contribute to UX work through wireframes, user flows and prototypes

• Create and maintain UI design systems, style guides, and documentation to support consistency and scalability across screens and features.

• Work directly with the Unity engine on pixel-perfect UI Implementation and asset performance optimization

Life at SYBO

In your first month, you’ll dive into our tools, pipelines, and the people behind them. You’ll get to know the direction of the game, the feel of the team, and slowly start contributing to UI work and discussions.

Within 3 months, you’re now owning key UI assignments. You collaborate closely with game design, and your work is directly shaping and refining the player journey.

By 12 months, you’ve become a core part of the team’s creative engine - raising the bar for UI art and design, pushing for polish, and helping define what great looks like at SYBO. Maybe even beyond your own game team.

**Requirements

**

• A strong portfolio demonstrating solid UI work for games, with clear examples of creating intuitive, polished, and engaging UIs.

• Ability to follow - and build on - an established art direction

• Some experience creating wireframes, user flows and mockups - we don’t expect you to be a UX expert, but we expect you to be the UI expert, and have a solid grasp of how that fits into UX.

• Skilled at designing, rendering - and possibly animating - high-quality UI elements that bring personality and clarity to the player experience.

• Proficiency with modern UI/UX and prototyping tools, particularly Figma.

• Experience working with Unity or similar engines, and a solid understanding of UI implementation

Bonus Points

• Experience working on large-scale live service mobile games.

**About SYBO

**We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

Not in Copenhagen? Not a problem! We have in-house relocation specialists who will help you relocate, and feel right at home in Copenhagen and at SYBO!

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.occupation: VP of Sales - be the first Sales leader at proprty.ai 🚀
jobs.description:
Our technology is proven, and customers across Denmark, Norway, and Germany are seeing real value. Now we're looking for our first Sales leader to help build the team!

You'll own go-to-market execution across Denmark, Norway, and the Netherlands, and eventually in new markets. You'll work closely with our founder and CEO. You'll set the team's direction and own the results, but you're never building alone. The founder is your strategic sparring partner on key deals and market decisions.

We're looking for someone who knows what early-stage startup sales takes, someone who wants to help build the playbook, grow the team, and still get in the room to personally run the sales process while that team comes together. You'll join at the point where the product is proven, the first customers are the proof, and the ceiling is largely set by how well you build the machine.

**🧠 What We're Looking For

**You've built or scaled a sales function before, ideally across multiple markets. You're as comfortable coaching a rep through a deal as you are picking up the phone to run one yourself. You lead by doing - you know what sales leadership looks like in a startup where the playbook is still being written, and that motivates you.

You believe a sales process should be disciplined, structured, and methodical. You know that closing complex, enterprise-level B2B SaaS deals takes more than instinct. It takes process, coaching, and follow-through.

At proprty.ai, we're an AI-first company (it's in our name), so you're excited to build an AI-first sales organization, using the latest tools to work smarter.

**💼 Your Responsibilities

**

• Recruit, lead, and coach the sales team, including the BDRs and Sales Executives already in market, and grow the team as we expand

• Build and own the sales strategy and playbooks across Denmark, Norway, the Netherlands, and future markets

• Own revenue targets and pipeline health across all active markets

• Personally run and close new logos as a player-coach while the team scales up around you

• Own and evolve our sales process in HubSpot, keeping pipeline clean, consistent, and forecastable

• Partner closely with the founder on strategy, key deals, and market entry decisions

• Engage both technical and commercial decision-makers at property organizations, leading enterprise deal cycles from the front

• Connect Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, and feed market and customer insight back into product and GTM strategy

**🧩 Who You Are

**

• Proven experience leading or building a B2B SaaS sales function, having hired and managed a team of AEs and/or BDRs

• Strong track record in complex, enterprise-level B2B SaaS sales, with contracts ranging from six figures to over 1M DKK in ARR

• Willing to be hands-on and carry your own deals while you build out the team

• Experience with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDICC, ABM, and value-based selling

• Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures, and can hold each one accountable to its own numbers

• A builder mindset. You've worked in a startup or fast-paced environment before and know what it takes to succeed while the foundations are still being laid

• Based in Copenhagen. This is where the role is anchored, with potential travel to Norway, Germany, and future markets

• Fluent in Danish and English. Norwegian or German language skills are a strong plus given our current markets

• Experience in real estate, proptech, or sustainability-adjacent industries is a plus, not a requirement

Note on title: the exact title and seniority level (e.g. VP of Sales, Head of Sales) will be determined based on the experience of the successful candidate.

**🙌 Who We Are

**proprty.ai is a Danish AI SaaS start-up helping property portfolio owners make smarter, more sustainable decisions about their buildings. We automate technical condition assessments and generate data-driven maintenance plans that reduce risk, save money, and minimize CO₂.

We already work with some of Denmark's largest real estate players, with roughly 18% of the Danish residential property market under partnership, a strong anchor in Norway through OBOS, one of the country's largest and most influential real estate organizations, and our first customer signed in Germany as we build out that market.

We have a real problem to solve, and we're building the team to solve it at scale.

**☕ Ready for the next step?

**Send us your CV, your LinkedIn profile, and a short note on why this role is right for you. If you have what it takes, we'd love to talk.

**Job Description Summary

**Activities contributing to the design, development, and lifecycle support of products, solutions, and systems. Includes activities linked to new product development and technical improvement of existing products and components. The role impacts approaches, projects, and programs within the functional area and supports both R&D and manufacturing activities. Impacts quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the team. Has significant input into technical priorities and engineering decisions. Guided by professional practices and policies while requiring a high level of operational judgment.

**Job Description

****Roles and Responsibilities

**

• Responsible for electronic hardware design and engineering, including designing, developing, modifying, and evaluating electronic circuits, assemblies, and subsystems for medical devices and other hardware systems. Common skill sets include Power Electronics, Analog, Digital, Mixed Signal, Power Management, Battery Systems, DC/DC Converters, Microcontrollers, and Embedded Hardware.

• Develop specialized knowledge within the power electronics discipline and serve as a technical resource within the team. Maintain awareness of the latest technical developments and contribute to engineering strategy, best practices, and technology decisions.

• Apply technical expertise to design robust, reliable, and manufacturable electronic solutions. Perform circuit analysis, hardware debugging, verification testing, root cause investigations, and evaluation of design alternatives.

• Support products throughout their lifecycle, including manufacturing support, production issue resolution, component obsolescence management, design improvements, and implementation of engineering changes.

• Use judgment to solve moderately complex technical problems across product development, manufacturing, quality, and supplier interactions. Take a practical and data-driven approach to identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions.

• Participate in Engineering Change Request (ECR) and Engineering Change Order (ECO) activities, including impact assessments, technical documentation, verification planning, and implementation of design changes.

• Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience. May lead small projects with moderate risks and resource requirements. Explains difficult or sensitive information and works across functions to build consensus and drive technical solutions.

**Required Qualifications

**

• Experience in Engineering/Technology and Electronic Hardware knowledge level is comparable to a Master's degree from an university or college (or equivalent relevant experience).

• Strong background in electronic hardware development with demonstrated experience in power electronics.

• Working knowledge of analog and digital electronics and the integration of complete electronic systems.

• Experience with laboratory testing, troubleshooting, debugging, and verification of electronic hardware.

• Experience supporting manufacturing activities, including root cause analysis, corrective actions, and implementation of hardware improvements.

**Desired Characteristics

**

• Strong experience with power electronics, power supplies, power management, battery-powered products, or related disciplines.

• Experience supporting products in production environments and working with manufacturing, quality, sourcing, and suppliers to resolve technical issues.

• Familiarity with ECR/ECO processes, design transfer, production launch, and lifecycle management activities.

• Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Established project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

******Additional Information

******Relocation Assistance Provided: No

Do you want to help solve the world's toughest problems with big data and AI? This is what we do every day at Databricks.

We are looking for a creative, execution-oriented Strategic Account Executive to join the team to maximise the phenomenal market opportunity that exists for Databricks within the Life Science industry. Your mission will be to grow one of our most strategic energy customers. Experience selling to this sector is essential, as is experience in running large complex multi-national accounts.

Reporting to the Strategic Sales Director for Denmark and Norway, as a Strategic Account Executive at Databricks you will come with an informed and compelling point of view on the Data, Analytics and AI space which will guide your successful strategy and together with both our teams and partners, allow you to provide exceptional value to our customers.

**The Impact You Will Have

**

• You will co-develop a business plan, with your team and ecosystem partners, that accelerates customer success to exceed quarterly/annual usage and booking goals

• You will lead your team, customers and partners to identify impactful data and AI use cases whilst proving out their value on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform

• You will implement the data and AI transformation goals of your customer through a combination of strategic partnerships, well-scoped professional services, training and targeted Executive Engagement

• You will develop an understanding of technical product details and roadmap to build trust with executives and technical champions

**What We Look For

**

• You will have experience developing strong relationships with large (global) Enterprises global accounts, managing virtual teams, and leading complex sales campaigns in major Energy accounts

• You will have experience working in Data, Cloud, or SaaS industries

• Proof of exceeding sales quotas in high-growth Enterprise software companies

• You will have experience driving usage and commit-based engagement models and strategies working with professional services and training teams

• You will have experience co-selling and scaling your business with Cloud Vendors (AWS, Azure and Google Cloud teams) and Global Solution Integrators (GSI)

• You will have experience co-developing business cases and gaining support from C-level Executives

• You will have experience of value-based selling

• Fluency in English is required, fluency in Danish is preferred

**About Databricks

**Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

**Benefits

**At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

**At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

**Compliance

**If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our Senior Power Electronics Engineer, you will play a key role in developing the next generation of variable speed drive solutions within our HVAC and Water Drives business. Working in a multidisciplinary engineering environment, you will transform system architectures and design concepts into robust, energy-efficient, and reliable products used by customers worldwide.

Your expertise in power electronics will help solve complex technical challenges while supporting the global transition toward electrification and improved energy efficiency.

By combining technical depth with strong collaboration skills, you will contribute to products that deliver lasting value for our customers and help build a more sustainable future.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**As part of a highly skilled engineering team, you will contribute across the full product development lifecycle, from concept and design through validation and continuous improvement.

• Design and develop power electronic solutions for next-generation variable speed drives, including simulation, prototyping, testing, and product validation.

• Drive the development and optimization of converter topologies, power stages, magnetic components, switch mode power supplies (SMPS), thermal solutions, and EMC-compliant designs.

• Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, including advanced power semiconductor technologies, including wide band gap semiconductors such as Silicon Carbide (SiC), to improve efficiency, performance, and reliability.

• Collaborate across systems, hardware, software, mechanical engineering, supply chain, and procurement to deliver solutions that meet customer and business requirements.

• Support verification, reliability, and continuous improvement activities, including design reviews, risk assessments, root cause analysis, and knowledge sharing within the engineering community.

• Contribute to functional safety considerations and robust design practices in close collaboration with system, hardware, software, and validation teams.

**What We're Looking For

**We're looking for an engineer who combines strong technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and a passion for solving complex engineering challenges.

• Master's degree in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• Several years of experience developing power electronic solutions for drives, inverters, or similar applications.

• Deep knowledge in one or more of these key power electronics areas: magnetics, SMPS, EMC, or functional safety.

• Experience using simulation tools such as PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice, or similar.

• Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

• Experience with reliability engineering, DFMEA, design verification, Design for Manufacturing principles, and wide band gap semiconductor technologies such as Silicon Carbide (SiC) will be considered an advantage.

We do not expect one candidate to master all areas. What matters most is that you bring strong expertise in selected areas and can help us strengthen and close competence gaps across our power electronics development activities.

**What You'll Get From Us

**In this role, you'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge power electronics technologies and help shape the future of energy-efficient drive solutions used around the world. You'll join a collaborative team where knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and innovation are part of everyday work.

You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you are passionate about power electronics and thrive on solving complex engineering challenges, this is your opportunity to make a real impact. Join Danfoss and help shape the next generation of innovative, reliable, and energy-efficient drive solutions used by customers around the world.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Turn insights into acquisition experiments that scale

**About Good Tape

**At Good Tape, we’re building tools that make working with voice and audio effortless. We help journalists, researchers, and organisations capture, transcribe, and analyse conversations at scale. Our team is small, ambitious, and deeply technical, and we care about reliability and craft.

**The role

**At Good Tape we are ready to level up. We've built up tons of data, a large user base, and a team that's eager to move fast.

We have a world class product, shipping speed and roadmap that warrants our ambition level.

We're looking for someone excited to own Good Tape's acquisition engine: performance marketing, SEO, creative and to fuel our sales motion with a steady flow of qualified demand. You'll report directly to our CCO and work closely with the broader commercial team: Sales, Data, Product Marketing and Customer Success. Your job is to make sure the right people see (and click on) us in the first place, and keep coming back.

It's a rare opportunity; endless data, a real user base and a world class product to market.

**What You'll Do

**Your responsibilities will include:

• Own performance marketing across paid channels, from strategy to execution.

• Drive SEO and organic acquisition, including content and site structure.

• Develop creative strategy and messaging for campaigns and launches.

• Own lifecycle and CRM: nurture flows, retention, and reactivation.

• Own top-of-funnel website content and landing pages; the pages that bring people in.

• Fuel SLG by partnering closely with Sales on positioning, demand gen, and maximizing MQL-to-SQL conversion.

• Feed acquisition learnings into the pricing and positioning conversations led by our CCO.

**What We’re Looking For

**

• A-can-do-mindset who are curious, humble and tech-savvy enough to build manual processes that we can later scale.

• An AI-first approach to problem solving

• Design skills (e.g. static/video ad creative) are a great plus, not a hard requirement

• Proactive, high-ownership mindset with strong cross-functional communication skills.

• Experience in data-driven marketing, growth experimentation, and core SaaS metrics.

• Thrives in a fast-paced startup environment with a proven ability to learn quickly.

**Why join Good Tape?

**

• Work in a small, focused, and highly skilled team where your impact is visible every day.

• Play a key role in shaping our brand, acquisition funnels, and demand gen engine.

• Help define how Good Tape reaches the people who need it.

• Bring passion and proactivity, and see it directly converted into pipeline and growth.

**Apply for the job

**We’re excited to see how you can help us make Good Tape even better for our users.

jobs.occupation: Application Excellence Manager - Chocolate and Confectionary
jobs.description:
**Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe.

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food — we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.

Everything we do is about **Making Better Happen™.

****AAK Location

**This role will be based at our site in Aarhus.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Global Application Excellence Manager to join AAK’s Applied Innovation organisation and serve as one of our global technical authorities within Chocolate & Confectionery Fats (CCF). Combining deep expertise in confectionery formulation, fat functionality and processing with innovation and industry knowledge, you will help strengthen AAK’s position as The Co-Development Company.

In this role, you will expand and strengthen AAK’s application knowledge by developing and validating customer-relevant proof points, leading lower-complexity product development projects and supporting Scientists on medium- and long-term innovation programmes. You will translate technical expertise into practical customer solutions that demonstrate the value of AAK’s portfolio.

Working alongside our other Global Application Excellence Manager – Chocolate & Confectionery, you will connect regional application experts, Customer Innovation teams, global functions and external industry stakeholders. You will help ensure knowledge and expertise are shared across regions, while identifying customer needs and market opportunities that can be translated into differentiated solutions and future innovation.

As a global technical reference point, you will support regional teams through technical guidance, training, customer projects and troubleshooting. You will also contribute to the development of AAK’s Confectionery Centre of Excellence and Customer Innovation Network, helping build capabilities and consistent application expertise across the organisation.

**Responsibilities

**

• Act as a global subject matter expert in Chocolate & Confectionery applications, with deep knowledge of CCF formulation, fat functionality, processing technologies and ingredient interactions.

• Connect regional application experts, Customer Innovation teams and global technical functions to strengthen knowledge sharing and ensure expertise is effectively leveraged across AAK.

• Design, develop and validate compelling application proof points that demonstrate customer value and differentiate AAK’s solutions.

• Lead lower-complexity product development projects while supporting Scientists on more complex, medium- and long-term innovation programmes.

• Translate new products and technologies into customer demonstrations, application evidence, technical documentation and materials that support successful commercialisation.

• Support regional teams with complex application and processing challenges through troubleshooting, technical guidance, customer workshops, factory trials and evaluations.

• Strengthen the Confectionery Centre of Excellence by developing application methods, evaluation protocols, best practices, technical tools and knowledge resources.

• Deliver AAK Academy training and technical learning programmes while supporting the development of the CCF Customer Innovation Network and wider technical capabilities.

• Analyse customer innovation projects and market developments to identify recurring needs, application gaps, future proof points and opportunities for new product development.

• Represent AAK within the wider confectionery ecosystem through relationships with suppliers, equipment manufacturers and industry experts, while supporting technology scouting and competitive benchmarking.

• Contribute to intellectual property activities, including technical evidence, application validation and competitive differentiation where relevant.

**About You

**

• MSc or PhD in Food Science, Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline.

• 8–10+ years of relevant industry experience within chocolate, confectionery, specialty fats or related food applications.

• Recognised expertise in Chocolate & Confectionery Fats, including formulation, fat functionality, ingredient interactions and processing technologies across applications such as chocolate, compounds, fillings, spreads and caramel.

• Proven experience in application development, product development, scale-up, customer trials and commercialisation.

• Ability to translate customer needs, market trends and technical knowledge into differentiated application solutions and compelling customer value.

• Experience working across global, cross-functional organisations, connecting technical experts and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Strong troubleshooting, process optimisation and communication skills, with a passion for knowledge sharing, capability building and mentoring.

• Experience with innovation processes, technology scouting, competitive benchmarking or intellectual property activities is an advantage; fluent in English and willing to travel internationally.

**In return AAK offers

**

• Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability.

• In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team.

• AAK invests in your development with training, mentorship, and clear career paths.

• You will contribute to a greener world with AAK's sustainability-focused approach.

• Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents.

**Contact and information

**For further information about the position, please contact Emily Lumb, Talent Acquisition Specialist: emily.lumb@aak.com

**About AAK

**Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialise in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable.

At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer with the flexibility of our production assets and deep knowledge across multiple industries, including Chocolate and Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.

Our 4,000 employees support close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and more than 20 production facilities worldwide. Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

AAK is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

Do you want to be a valued part of a global team that works passionately every day to ensure we deliver high-quality services to our customers by upholding high standards on food safety and a high level of business ethics in our supplier base? If this excites you then look no further and come join us.

About The Role Be part of the movement - and play your part.  As Administration Specialist, you are part of the Quality & Compliance team that supports the Danish based logistics legal entities with issues related to quality and compliance. In addition to direct support on the transportation and storage of dry, chilled and frozen goods, the team also supports quality assurance in a broader sense.

You will be supporting the Quality Specialists within certification processes, training and internal auditing. You will also be responsible for the day-to-day handling and coordination of the Global Haulage Compliance program where we, with assistance from external auditors, verify that our haulage partners comply with basic human rights and other regulations related to truck drivers.

You will report directly to the Global Director for Health, Safety & Security, and be based at our Logistics site in Taulov, Denmark. The role requires on-site presence.

**What kind of exciting challenges can you expect to meet in this role?:

****Role

**As Administration Specialist, you will get the opportunity to influence and develop the role, but the initial areas we expect you to cover are to:

• Administer the Haulage Compliance Audit program on a daily basis, including interaction with external suppliers, follow-up with internal stakeholders, planning and reporting

• Support the Quality Specialists in managing and controlling quality processes and food safety, across DFDS’ Danish storage, transportation and office locations

• Participate in regular QEHS audits and inspections of both internal locations as well as 3rd party partners as specified by the IFS/ISO standards

• Track and follow-up on non-conformances from the conducted audits and inspections in close collaboration with QEHS Experts

• Conduct internal audits of operational sites

• Participate in developing training material and facilitate training sessions

**About You

**We think that the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. With this in mind, we think that you are:

• A strong administrator

• A good communicator with strong interpersonal skills

• A good listener with ability to digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions

• Structured and self-driven with ability to prioritize and multitask in a dynamic environment

• A collaborative team player who enjoys collaborating with others

Moreover, we imagine that the ideal candidate brings:

• Relevant business experience in an administrative function

• Experience with quality assurance is an advantage

• Experience from a logistics or transport-oriented company is an advantage

• Experience with food safety and food transportation and storage is an advantage

• Experience with internal audits - or a willingness to gain knowledge in this area

• Full proficiency in Danish and English, both spoken and written (English is corporate language)

• The ability to convey training and information to others in a clear and engaging way

• Experience with the Microsoft 365 product suite

• Experience with developing marketing material or training material

Working at DFDS Join the movement and grow with us. While you’re with us, we want you to develop and move yourself on. We’ll encourage you to challenge yourself to acquire new skills and perspectives.

At DFDS, we promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Logistics facility in Taulov, we are placed right in the middle of all our logistics facilities in Denmark and with our global headquarter in Copenhagen only a few hours away.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.

If you think your personality, skills, experience and aspirations match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Send us your CV and a brief motivational letter (in English) as soon as possible as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

Is there something you need to know, we haven’t covered here, please do not hesitate to reach out to Global Director Health, Safety & Security (Landside) Steffen Conradsen on sconr@dfds.com.

Please note that response times may be slightly longer than usual due to the autumn holiday period and business travel activities within the hiring team, however, rest assured that we will get back to you at earliest convenience.

**We look forward to hearing from you.

**This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

Are you an experienced and motivated OT Security Architect and do you want to leave your mark on the global energy industry? If so, we want to hear from you!

Your position

In your new position as OT Security Architect in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the OT Security Team, whose mission is to ensure excellent OT security deliveries on large-scale EPC substation projects. You will have the chance to take the architectural lead and help shape a collaborative team culture built on expertise and knowledge-sharing. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be at one of our offices in either Esbjerg, Aarhus or Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel 10–30 days per year.

“Every day, we help enable the green energy transition by building secure, resilient OT solutions that ensure renewable energy assets operate safely and reliably.” - OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.

Your tasks & responsibilities

In our Renewables division, we have major EPC projects in the pipeline for both short- and long-term operations. As an OT Security Architect, you will take the architectural lead and support all OT Security areas across the EPC substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Contributing to the implementation of industry-accepted good practice and required Cyber/OT Security architecture at solution level, typically based on standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and NIS

• Helping define products and standards relevant to OT Security and infrastructure

• Hands-on experience with cybersecurity audits and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Critical Infrastructure regulations, and IEC 62443

• Reviewing requirements/ITT packages and providing input to tenders consisting of calculations, solutions, descriptions, clarifications, and reservations

• Taking on an advisory or active role in infrastructure, identity access management, or logging/event-based activities

• Being responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing FAT, SAT, and SIT activities to ensure successful system delivery and integration

• Implementing customer-specific Cyber/OT Security requirements in substation design for multiple systems and subsystems, such as SCADA, low-voltage, HVAC, Auxiliary Control and Monitoring System, etc.

Crucial to this position is your ability to take ownership of project deliverables and coordinate OT Security deadlines with internal and external stakeholders. You should thrive in a leading role where your skills, collaboration, and structured approach help ensure that requirements are met.

Your profile & qualifications

You are a team player who enjoys leading projects and working with stakeholders to align on timing, scope, and objectives. You know when technical expertise should be brought in to support delivery. To us, this means that you have a structured and solution-oriented approach, the ability to influence stakeholders, and the dedication to see tasks through to completion.

You will be part of a team of six colleagues that values quality, attention to detail, and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, and we work in a dedicated, structured, and execution-focused way while respecting the agility that is a natural part of our core tasks. We want the same from you.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT Security from a similar position

• A Tech Lead mentality – we are not seeking an extreme subject matter expert, but a well-rounded colleague who can work through heavily structured large projects involving many stakeholders

• The ability to know when additional technical specialists or resources are needed to complete a project

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English

• Experience working in complex engineering projects, as well as project and stakeholder management, is an advantage

If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

**Service Desk Technician - Network

**Would you like to work hands-on with B2B network operations and help keep critical digital infrastructure running? In this role, you will take ownership of customer cases, troubleshoot network-related issues and make sure the right actions are taken when services are affected.

**What You Need To Succeed

**

• Relevant education in IT/ networking.

• Experience working with network products and a good understanding of network structures.

• Professional communication skills in both Danish and English.

• Experience working in a structured way with operational cases, where you prioritise according to SLAs and business criticality.

**About The Role And The Team

**You will join a specialised team supporting GlobalConnect’s B2B customers within network and security services. Based primarily at our Copenhagen office, you will work closely with colleagues to solve incidents, share knowledge and ensure effective handovers.

The role combines technical troubleshooting with customer communication. You will be responsible for keeping cases moving from the first contact through follow-up, resolution or the correct handover.

The role follows a planned 24/7 shift rotation with a mix of daytime, evening and night shift****s, including evening shifts around 15–23 and night shifts around 23–07. Weekend shifts are also part of the rotation.

The schedule is planned in advance and includes longer periods of consecutive days off, including full weeks off at certain points in the rotation. This gives you a combination of varied working hours and longer stretches of time away from work.

**What You’ll Be Working On

**

• Receive and handle B2B customer enquiries by phone and through our systems.

• Take ownership of cases and prioritise them according to severity, SLAs, escalations and business criticality.

• Troubleshoot and work proactively with incidents and alarms related to network and security products.

• Follow up with customers and suppliers in accordance with agreed SLAs.

• Ensure clear handovers between shifts, colleagues and departments.

• Contribute to quality assurance of customer solutions and participate in customer meetings when needed.

**Who We Are Looking For

**You enjoy combining technical problem-solving with customer contact and take responsibility for moving your cases forward. You can maintain an overview when priorities change or a customer situation becomes critical, and you communicate technical information clearly to people with different levels of technical knowledge.

Experience from telecommunications or IT would be useful, as would knowledge of SD-WAN, Layer 2 and Layer 3. Experience with Cisco, Juniper or similar network equipment, ServiceNow, ITIL or network certifications such as CCNA, JNCIA or ACMA would also be an advantage.

Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you.

**Our recruitment process

**

• Talent Acquisition Screening Interview

• Hiring Manager interview

• Personality and ability tests feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition

• References

• Final alignment meeting

**Practical information

**

• Location: Copenhagen.

• The role is primarily office-based.

• GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this role.

You will get the opportunity to work with B2B network and security services, take ownership of operational customer cases and collaborate closely with colleagues in a specialised team.

No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!

**About Us

**GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.

We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

A property manager can handle 600 tenants. That's the industry limit. Why? Because the work scales linearly: matching bank transactions to invoices, chasing late payments, answering tenant questions, coordinating repairs, preparing legal notices, renewing leases. More tenants, more of the same manual work.

With AI, that limit disappears. And both landlords and tenants get a better experience.

**About Rumli

**Eight years in property operations. ~1,000 customers across Denmark, the Netherlands, and Germany. We know this industry: the workflows, the pain points, the regulations.

Now we're making a big move: becoming a property manager. Tenant communication, bookkeeping, coordinating repairs. We handle it all. A landlord shouldn't chase late payments or find a plumber at 10 pm. We do it for them.

We're building an entirely new platform to power this. AI-native from day one. Profitable, real customers, expanding across the Nordics.

**Why this is interesting

**Property management is a great domain for a product engineer. Thousands of similar transactions, pattern-based decisions, templated documents. And 1,000 customers who will tell you exactly where it hurts. Years of domain knowledge, ready to turn into a product.

We ship with AI agents built into the workflow. Our codebase has custom skills to improve our workflow. AI writes a lot of the code; we review it. That means the slow part of building isn't writing code anymore. It's knowing what to build. That's what this role is about.

**The role

**You are autonomous and independent, working with the team to solve property managers' pains and make them as efficient as possible.

• Talk to customers and property managers. Find out what actually slows them down

• Decide what to build, then build it. Mockup, prototype, ship, measure, repeat

• Own features end-to-end. Database to API to UI

• Build AI into core product features

• Work directly with our co-founder on product direction

We need someone who looks at a messy problem and figures out what to build, and doesn't wait for a spec.

**Tech stack

**TypeScript everywhere. But does it even matter anymore?

• Frontend: Next.js, React, Shadcn, Tailwind CSS

• Backend: NestJS, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM

• Infra: AWS Lambda, CDK, RDS, EventBridge, SQS

**What We're Looking For

**

• Product thinking. You understand what it takes to build a profitable product. You are not here just to handle tickets.

• Strong product mindset. Agents can code, but they need scoping and steering.

• You've shipped things people actually use, and you can show them.

• Comfortable talking to customers.

• Experience with coding agents.

• Work independently.

• Copenhagen-based (on-site).

Big plus: AWS, AI experience (prompt engineering, RAG, agents), fintech/proptech background, a side project you're proud of.

**Compensation & Benefits

**

• Compensation: 50–65K DKK, depending on experience and demonstrated competencies

• Equity: Employee warrants offering real ownership in the company

• Workspace: Centrally located Copenhagen office

• Perks: Daily lunch included

**Why Rumli?

**Real customers. Brand-new codebase. Small team where your decisions matter.

We're rebuilding from the ground up with AI as the foundation. If you want to decide what property software should do, not just build what someone else specified, reach out.

Building scalable manufacturing operations requires more than improving individual processes. It requires production systems designed for flow, teams capable of sustaining change, and a continuous improvement culture that turns operational challenges into measurable business results.

As our Operational Excellence Manager, you will play a key role in NOVENCO’s future manufacturing strategy. You will lead a small team of Production Technicians and Engineers, develop and optimise production systems, introduce new production lines, and drive Lean and continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation.

**Your Impact

**

• Design and implement new production lines and manufacturing layouts, improving flow, efficiency, safety, quality and scalability while supporting NOVENCO’s future production requirements.

• Lead Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement initiatives using Lean methodologies including Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, root cause analysis and standardisation to reduce waste and improve operational performance.

• Drive cross-functional improvement and transformation projects, working across Production, Engineering, Quality and other functions to improve productivity, lead time and manufacturing effectiveness.

• Lead and develop a small team of Production Technicians and Engineers, building a highly engaged and high-performing team capable of delivering operational improvements and supporting production development.

• Integrate manufacturing requirements into new product development and industrialisation, ensuring new products and processes are designed with efficient and scalable production in mind.

• Support the introduction and ramp-up of new production lines, developing operational standards, work instructions and training materials while ensuring employees are prepared for new processes and ways of working.

• Build Lean and Continuous Improvement capabilities across the organisation, coaching employees and leaders and facilitating workshops that enable teams to identify and implement sustainable improvements themselves.

• Measure and sustain improvement initiatives, ensuring projects translate into tangible improvements in productivity, quality, lead time and overall operational efficiency.

**What Drives Success

**You combine strong manufacturing knowledge with the ability to turn improvement opportunities into practical, sustainable change.

You will likely bring:

• At least 5 years of relevant experience within Operational Excellence, Continuous Improvement, Lean Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering or a comparable manufacturing improvement role.

• Proven experience designing, implementing or optimising production lines within a manufacturing environment.

• Strong practical knowledge of Lean manufacturing and Continuous Improvement methodologies, including Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, root cause analysis and process standardisation.

• Experience leading cross-functional improvement projects, workshops and transformation initiatives from identification through implementation.

• The ability to influence change across an organisation, working effectively with operators, specialists, engineers, managers and senior leadership.

• Strong coaching and facilitation capabilities, with experience developing Lean and Continuous Improvement capabilities in others.

• A structured and analytical approach to problem-solving combined with a willingness to work hands-on with production teams.

• Strong project management and organisational capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple improvement initiatives simultaneously.

• Experience leading or developing technical employees and creating an engaged, performance-oriented team environment.

**Real Impact

**Imagine a new production line is being introduced to support NOVENCO’s future manufacturing requirements.

Rather than simply installing equipment and adapting processes afterwards, you bring Production, Engineering, Quality and other stakeholders together early. You map the value stream, challenge unnecessary process steps, optimise material and operator flow, establish standardised ways of working and prepare the production team for launch.

Once production begins, you monitor performance, identify bottlenecks and lead targeted improvement activities.

The result is a production line that reaches its performance targets faster, with stronger productivity, quality and operational stability while leaving the organization with the knowledge and capabilities to continue improving it.

**What We Offer

**

• A central role in shaping NOVENCO’s future manufacturing and Operational Excellence strategy.

• The opportunity to design and implement new production systems rather than simply optimise existing processes.

• Direct influence on productivity, quality, lead time and operational performance across our manufacturing organisation.

• Leadership responsibility for a small team of Production Technicians and Engineers.

• Close collaboration across Production, Engineering, Quality and other functions.

• The opportunity to build Lean and Continuous Improvement capabilities across the organisation and create sustainable operational change.

• Competitive salary of 50K - 60K DKK Per month and employee benefits in line with company policy.

• 25 days’ annual leave plus 5 days Feriefri after the qualifying period.

• Standard auto-enrolment pension scheme and access to a healthcare scheme.

• Professional development and training through NOVENCollege.

**Context

**The CI Project Manager / Operational Excellence Expert is based at NOVENCO Building & Industry’s headquarters and manufacturing facility in Næstved, Denmark, and reports directly to the Plant Manager.

This is an on-site manufacturing role requiring close collaboration with production teams and other functions across the organisation.

The position combines Continuous Improvement, Lean Manufacturing, production development, project leadership and people leadership, with responsibility for creating both immediate operational improvements and sustainable long-term capabilities.

**How To Apply

**Please submit your CV via our careers site. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be scheduled as suitable candidates are identified.

NOVENCO Building & Industry is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Job posting for Student Instructors at Cognitive Science and Linguistics

Spring 2027

We are looking to hire six-seven student instructors from 1 January to 31 may 2027 for the following courses:

BSc in Cognitive Science:

• Philosophy of Cognitive Science (2 hours/week, 13 weeks)

• Methods 2: General Linear Model (4 hours/week, 13 weeks – two instructors)

• Cognitive Neuroscience (2 hours/week, 11 weeks)

• Methods 4: Bayesian Computational Modeling (2 hours/week, 11 weeks)

• Social and Cultural Dynamics (2 hours/week, 11 weeks)

MA in Linguistics:

• Computational Linguistics (2 hours/week, 12 weeks)

Programming skills necessary - see course description.

BA in Linguistics:

• Studiume Generale (2 hours/week, 13 weeks) (please notice; course in Danish)

Qualifications

Applicants should have:

• A solid background in the relevant academic areas for the position, including good grades for the course they are applying for, and other related courses.

• Good communication skills, including the ability to work well with course coordinators, the ability to communicate well with students, and the ability to facilitate discussion and collaboration between students.

• The ability to help course coordinators in preparing class activities, and to interpret and implement class plans in a clear and organized way.

• Is enrolled as a student at Aarhus University when teaching.

We recommend that you participate in a basic pedagogical course for student instructors, lasting approx. 12 hours. Participation in the course as an instructor is paid once during your study period.

Terms of employment

In most courses, instructors will be required to teach a total of 26 hours. For each hour taught, instructors will receive 1.5 hours paid preparation time, for a total of 65 paid hours. If the instructor has to teach the same content to two different classes, the preparation time for class two will only be 0.75 hours paid preparation time, for a total of 55,25 paid hours.

The hourly rate of pay is DKK 291,80, including holiday pay.

Application process

When applying, please attach your application letter, CV, and grade transcripts.

You are more than welcome to apply for more than one course, please write your prioritized order for the courses. Each course requires a separate application. You will need to write them in the same document or attach it as extra attachments in the application system.

Each application should include a letter stating:

• Which course you are applying to serve as instructor for.

• A short motivation for your application for that course.

• A short description of relevant knowledge and skills for the role of instructor, specific to the course you are applying for.

Application letters for each course should be no longer than a single A4 page.

The deadline is 9 November, and we hope to get back to you before Christmas.

If you have any questions, please contact Head of Department, Joshua Charles Skewes at afdelingsleder.lics@cc.au.dk.

Job Description

Do you have solid experience leading large-scale IT projects? Are you motivated by delivering innovative IT solutions to complex, society-critical challenges? If so, you may be our next colleague in the role of IT Manager at Netcompany. As a Manager, you will be challenged in a position that requires strong leadership capabilities as well as technical expertise.

Responsibilities and technologies

As an IT Manager, you will be responsible for leading large-scale IT projects from initiation through successful delivery. You will manage project teams, oversee project risks, and ensure high standards of quality, delivery, and stakeholder satisfaction. In addition, you will play a key role in client advisory services, business development activities, and proposal management.

Beyond your leadership responsibilities, you will be expected to contribute with strong technical expertise. You will act as a trusted advisor and sparring partner on technical solution design and implementation, helping project teams and clients solve complex challenges.

Alongside your project management responsibilities, you will serve as a mentor to consultants and senior consultants. This long-term mentoring relationship will give you the opportunity to support, guide, and contribute to the professional development of your mentees throughout their careers at Netcompany.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Leading projects and ensuring successful delivery and progress, typically based on agile development methodologies.

• Participating in steering committee meetings with senior representatives from both Netcompany and the client organization.

• Advising the client on project deliverables.

• Coordinating activities across multiple project workstreams, including testing, organizational implementation, and software development.

• Leading proposal teams and conducting development and performance discussions with your mentees.

About you

We expect you to hold a masters's degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you have:

• 
Strong technical expertise and relevant experience within the IT industry.

• 
Proven experience leading large and complex IT delivery projects, including projects utilizing agile development methodologies.

• 
Strong commercial awareness combined with the ability to build trust and lead high-performing teams.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

As a Consulting Solution Architect for the Data Management domain, you will serve as a trusted advisor throughout consulting engagements — helping clients shape feasible solution options, leading or supporting the design of custom, high‑value solutions, and ensuring strong domain integrity aligned with the broader SimCorp One solution design. You will play a central role in supporting scalable, high‑quality custom implementations and contribute to consistency and excellence across our Consulting organization.

You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Consulting, Product Management, and Value Streams to ensure our custom solutions remain both feasible and aligned to SimCorp standards. You will also help advance our practices, strengthen our knowledge base, and mentor the next generation of solutioning talent within SimCorp.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As SimCorp embarks on the SimCorp One journey, the Consulting Solution Architect plays a critical role in enabling the Consulting organization to deliver high‑quality, scalable custom solutions. Consulting Solution Architects ensure that custom client requirements are shaped and delivered with strong domain integrity, consistency, and alignment with SimCorp’s delivery methodologies (Compass) and the SimCorp One solution.

You will:

• Influence key architectural decisions in strategic and complex consulting projects

• Strengthen our consulting methodologies and enablement efforts

• Contribute to the evolution of consulting solution best practices and patterns

Our new Consulting Solution Architects bring deep domain experience within the scope of the Data Management Sub-Service Line and the consulting skills needed to act as trusted advisors to internal and external clients.

This is a global position, with potential locations across SimCorp offices worldwide. International travel may be required based on client needs. The role reports to the Global Practice Lead.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

****Global Practice Ownership

**

• Own the Global consulting practice within your domain. This includes ownership of the global consulting artifacts for your domain.

• Contribute with structured feedback into standards evolution.

• Shape and define our consulting practice within your domain.

• Support the enablement of consultants to deliver custom client solutions with high quality, consistency, and aligned with the SimCorp One solution.

**Scoping & Advisory

**

• Lead or support domain‑specific consulting scoping during sales and early project phases for complex and strategic consulting engagements

• Act as the key advisor for solution options and custom feasibility

• Collaborate with Sales, Engagement Leads, Product Management, and Value Streams

• Define and validate custom architecture and design in complex and strategic client projects

• Ensure custom build quality and provide ongoing design assurance

• Resolve domain-specific challenges in collaboration with consulting, value streams, and product teams

**Knowledge Enablement

**

• Document and disseminate domain knowledge and best practices

• Support onboarding and capability building within Consulting

• Collaborate on cross‑functional learning initiatives

**Collaboration & Influence

**

• Work closely with Product Management, Value Streams, and project teams

• Represent your domain in discussions on solution direction and domain challenges

• Interface with clients, including senior stakeholders, on custom solution matters

**Mentoring & Community Leadership

**

• Coach consultants and aspiring architects

• Help grow solutioning maturity within Consulting

• Influence cross‑domain architecture discussions and knowledge sharing

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to excel at several of the following skills and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest.

• Relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics or a relevant Business degree

• At least 7+ years of proven experience designing and implementing SimCorp Dimension solutions

• Deep business knowledge within the Data Management domain. Experience with the SimCorp Data Management Core solution and the SimCorp Data Management Service is a plus.

• Understanding of our clients’ general business processes and operating model

• International experience and global mindset

• Have been involved in several SimCorp Dimension implementations from the early stages of the project

• Ability to build relationships, drive discussions and impact stakeholders when required

• Engagement in partnering with various parts of the SimCorp organization

• Proactiveness, creativeness and commercial mindedness with a global perspective

• Proficiency in English

**Benefits

**SimCorp offers several benefits that might play a significant factor in considering whether to accept a job offer. Since SimCorp operates in 30+ offices worldwide, the benefits package may vary from country to country.

Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please click below to apply. For further information about the position, please contact Kasper Bøgh Larsen, Global Practice Lead Data and Post Trade or Hanna Brzózka, Lead Talent Acquisition Partner at hanna.brzozka@simcorp.com to learn more about the vacancy, recruitment process or SimCorp internal transfer policy.

**Please note that only applications sent through our Workday system will be processed.

**In addition to submitting your CV please add a short Cover Letter motivating your interest elaborating on:

• What is your vision for yourself as a Solution Architect?

• What do you hope to accomplish?

• How will you work together with the GPL and other Solution Architects to advance both your and SimCorp’s visions?

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

__________

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

**About TimeLog

TimeLog is a leading Professional Services Automation (PSA) software, dedicated to helping professional service organizations streamline business processes and boost productivity. TimeLog fills the GAP between Project Managers and the Finance Department in the consulting business, empowering Project Managers to manage project financials in a way compliant with the requirements set by finance.

**About The Role

**We're seeking a Quality Engineer to build our testing capabilities and quality assurance practices from the ground up. This is a high-impact role where you'll help establish the best practices, standards, and culture that define how we deliver quality software at TimeLog. You'll have the opportunity to influence our testing strategy from scratch while working hands-on to implement automated test suites across our web applications and APIs. The role is based in Denmark. Please see Practicalities below before applying.

At TimeLog, we're looking for someone who embodies a "Product Engineer" mindset. Someone who doesn't see QA as a gatekeeper role, but as an enabler of quality throughout the development process. You'll take end-to-end responsibility for quality outcomes, working collaboratively with development teams rather than as a final checkpoint. Your success will be measured by how well you enable engineering teams to build quality into their work from the start.

As part of a small, focused team, you'll be expected to take initiative and lead the technical direction for all things quality. This is both a hands-on technical role (building test suites, writing automation code) and a strategic leadership position (defining what to automate versus manually test, determining where to invest effort for maximum impact). You'll have significant autonomy and influence over how we approach quality across the entire organization.

Key responsibilities

• Design and build automated end-to-end test suites for our web applications and APIs using modern testing frameworks like Playwright.

• Establish and evangelize testing standards, best practices, and patterns across Product Development teams.

• Develop and implement a comprehensive regression testing strategy that ensures release confidence while minimizing test execution time.

• Make strategic decisions about what to automate versus manually test, optimizing for bug detection impact relative to effort invested.

• Ensure quality for customer migrations from our legacy product to our new cloud-native platform, including data validation and end-to-end migration testing.

• Integrate automated tests into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines to provide fast feedback on code changes.

• Over time, establish non-functional testing practices (load, performance and reliability testing) as the automation foundation matures.

• Collaborate across development teams as a QA partner and advisor.

• Create comprehensive test documentation, runbooks, and quality metrics dashboards to provide visibility into product quality.

• Upskill and mentor engineers on testing practices, test design principles, and automation techniques.

• Implement test monitoring and observability to track test effectiveness, flakiness, and coverage over time.

• Determine appropriate test environment strategies and test data management approaches that support efficient testing workflows.

Required experience and skills

**Testing expertise

**

• Extensive experience with end-to-end test automation using frameworks like Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar tools.

• Strong knowledge of API testing approaches and tools for REST services.

• Deep understanding of test design principles including test pyramids, coverage strategies, and risk-based testing.

• Proven experience building test infrastructure and automation frameworks from scratch.

**CI/CD and DevOps

**

• Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, preferably with Azure DevOps.

• Understanding of deployment patterns, release processes, and how testing fits into continuous delivery workflows.

• Experience with test environment management, test data strategies, and managing test dependencies.

**Technical Skills

**

• Strong programming and scripting abilities. Comfortable writing maintainable test code and automation scripts (C#/.NET experience is a plus given our Microsoft technology stack).

• Solid understanding of web application architecture, HTTP/REST APIs, and modern web technologies.

• Proficiency with Git version control and experience working in agile development environments.

• Comfortable working in both Linux and Windows environments.

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience with load and performance testing tools such as k6, JMeter or Azure Load Testing, and the ability to reason about system behaviour under load and identify bottlenecks.

• Familiarity with performance monitoring and observability practices, and with instrumenting tests for diagnosability.

• Experience with the Microsoft testing ecosystem including xUnit, NUnit, and Azure DevOps Test Plans for test case management and exploratory testing.

• Knowledge of .NET/C# development and familiarity with the Microsoft development toolchain.

• Container and Kubernetes testing experience, including testing in containerized environments.

• Security testing practices and vulnerability assessment experience.

• Knowledge of compliance and regulatory testing requirements in enterprise software.

• Familiarity with chaos engineering and reliability testing practices.

• Experience testing data pipelines and ETL processes, including data quality validation, schema testing, and pipeline reliability (e.g., in Databricks, Apache Spark, or similar platforms).

• Familiarity with data testing frameworks such as Great Expectations, dbt tests, or similar tools for asserting data correctness and completeness.

What We're Looking For

• Ownership mentality that extends beyond writing tests to caring about overall quality outcomes and customer satisfaction.

• Platform/QA-as-a-product thinking: treating testing infrastructure and capabilities as products you're building for internal engineering customers.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to explain testing concepts to engineers, product managers, and leadership alike.

• Interest in understanding the business context and product strategy behind testing requirements.

Practicalities

• Location: this is a hybrid role with regular on-site presence at one of our offices (Copenhagen, Aarhus or Aalborg). It is not a remote position, including from elsewhere in the Nordics.

• Eligibility: you must already live in Denmark, or commute daily across the Øresund, and hold the right to work here. We are not able to offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role.

• Language: the working language in Product Development is English. Danish is a plus, not a requirement.

What you'll gain

• Work with modern testing tools, frameworks, and cloud-native technologies in an Azure/Microsoft environment.

• Collaborate with talented engineering teams on challenging technical problems.

• Shape the quality culture and testing practices for the entire engineering organization.

• Professional development in emerging QA practices, automation techniques, and modern testing approaches.
